adjudicated_pairs.intent_summary: How to recognize Christ's visible Church by her identifying marks
adjudicated_pairs.rationale: The two English prompts are paraphrases asking how to identify the true Church founded by Christ. Both anchor to the four marks, rather than independent subquestions.

adjudicated_pairs.intent_summary: Why busy priestly ministry cannot replace meditation or interior prayer
adjudicated_pairs.rationale: One prompt asks why priests need meditation despite their pastoral duties; the other asks whether those duties can replace interior prayer. Both are answered by Pius X's direct rejection of the busyness excuse.
